newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Lionore readies Forrestania Gold bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Lionore readies Forrestania Gold bid.

text.p: Vancouver-based Lionore Mining International Ltd said on Wednesday it had received the necessary financing to proceed with its takeover bid for Australian miner Forrestania Gold NL in early February.

Lionore last November said it intended to make a friendly cash and scrip takeover offer for Perth-based Forrestania that valued Forrestania shares at A$3.35 each. Forrestania shares were trading unchanged at A$2.53 in late trading on Wednesday.

Capital Group Ltd, the merchant banking arm of the Toronto Dominion Bank, has committed to provide a US$30 million bridge loan, Lionore said. In addition, First Marathon and TD Securities have committed to raise US$34 million from the sale of Lionore Special Warrants convertible to 17 million shares at US$2.00 per share, increasing the outstanding common shares of Lionore to 77.3 million, the company said.
Lionore currently holds 19.5 percent of Forrestania.
Forrestania is a gold producer and a nickel and gold explorer. It has an advanced nickel development project in a 50-50 joint venture with Gencor Ltd of South Africa.
The company said it expects to produce 160,000 ounces of gold in 1997, all hedged at a minimum price of US $420/ounce.
